column1: # Reviewed candidates of tools/check-do-while.py, one per line (docs/status.md 3.636).  The gate
# looks for a port `if COND { break; }` whose COND is textually C's own `do { ... } while (COND);`
# condition - which is what an *un-negated* transcription looks like (PORTING.md P-95).  The gate
# pairs conditions per unit, so a legitimate *inner* break can carry the same text as a different
# loop's condition; those are reviewed here.  A candidate with no row, a row whose C line does not
# match, and a row that matches no candidate are all failures.
